run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T08:42:08Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by frontend's dependency on the single-replica ad service, whose only pod (ad-554b849958-l9ft5) began crash-looping around 08:41 with repeated OOMKilled container terminations. The ad pod is not Ready, the ad Service has only a notReadyAddress and no ready endpoint, and frontend's client-side grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans turn to error status in the 5-minute bucket ending 08:42:08 — the same instant the alert started. Those failing client calls have no corresponding ad server-side span, so they failed before reaching the ad application. Frontend's error spans are confined to the /api/data request path (GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds — 552 each, plus 19.28 tcp.connect errors); all other frontend operations show 0 error spans, and frontend's own pod is Ready with 0 restarts, so the failures are dependency-driven rather than a frontend runtime fault. frontend-proxy records its own ingress and 'router frontend egress' error spans with the same onset. The deeper trigger — steady ad container memory growth from 331MB to 372MB between 08:16 and 08:41 against a 450Mi limit, no probes and no second replica — is supported by the observed growth and configuration, but the exact peak that killed the container was not captured and the span-level error text was not observable because Jaeger holds no frontend traces after ~08:32.

claims.text: In the window 2026-11-15T07:42:08Z–08:59:41Z frontend recorded 2227.28 spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 101733.40 STATUS_CODE_UNSET. Error spans are confined to: GET 552, GET /api/data 552, executing api route (pages) /api/data 552, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 552 and tcp.connect 19.279; all other frontend operations (GET /api/cart, POST, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) show 0.

Frontend errors begin in the 5-minute bucket ending 08:42:08: the 300s increase of error spans for GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds was 0 at every evaluation from 08:17:08 through 08:37:08, then 36.67 (08:42:08), 256.67 (08:47:08) and 188.39 (08:52:08). In the same series the STATUS_CODE_UNSET counts for 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fell to 0 at 08:47:08 and 08:52:08, while tcp.connect error spans appeared (10, 4.444, 4.433).

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas 1 with readyReplicas null, availableReplicas null and unavailableReplicas 1; its only pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is phase Running but Ready=False reason ContainersNotReady ('containers with unready status: [ad]'), and its ad container has restartCount 4, ready=false, started=false, current state terminated with exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled finishedAt 2026-11-15T08:44:24Z, and lastState terminated with exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled finishedAt 2026-11-15T08:43:22Z.

Kubelet events on ad-554b849958-l9ft5 include a Warning BackOff event 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo(...)' with count 23, firstTimestamp 2026-11-15T08:41:22Z and lastTimestamp 2026-11-15T08:49:01Z; the Normal Started/Created/Pulled events have count 6 each (first 08:03:47Z, last 08:45:53Z). No Evicted or Unhealthy event was returned for the ad objects.

The Endpoints object 'ad' has no ready addresses: its only subset holds notReadyAddresses [{ip 100.96.2.230, nodeName i-0d81a0f472ebdc704, targetRef pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5}] on port tcp-service 8080, whereas the 'frontend' Endpoints object has a ready address 100.96.2.78 (pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx).

The ad workload runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with container resources limits {cpu 50m, memory 450Mi} and requests {cpu 10m, memory 225Mi} and declares no readinessProbe and no livenessProbe (the running pod's spec carries the same limits and QoS class Burstable). The pod is owned by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (created 2026-11-15T08:03:44Z), which is controlled by Deployment ad.

cAdvisor shows the ad container working set rising steadily from 331,190,272 bytes at 08:16:08 to 371,867,648 bytes at 08:41:08 (then flat at that value through 08:45:08), and seven distinct ad container cgroup instances exist in the pod with peak usage 372,563,968; 189,325,312; 184,614,912; 123,789,312; 67,387,392; 49,790,976 and 3,305,472 bytes, consistent with successive restarted container instances.

The ad service's own server spans show no GetAds errors: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 1348.54 spans, all STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the only ad error-span series in the window is flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at 2.033. The same EventStream operation is the only error series for recommendation (3.044) and fraud-detection (3.048), and accounting/payment error series read 0.

Frontend-side versus ad-side GetAds volume: frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds has 1354.63 STATUS_CODE_UNSET plus 552 STATUS_CODE_ERROR (about 1906 calls) in the window, while ad's server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds has 1348.54 spans in total, so roughly 552 failing frontend client spans have no corresponding ad server-side span.

In the final 10 minutes (08:49:41–08:59:41) the frontend operation GET /api/data recorded 55.80 error-status spans and 0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans, i.e. every recorded span of that operation in that window carried error status.

frontend-proxy's own errors start in the same period: the 300s error increase for span 'router frontend egress' was 0 at 08:34:41 and 08:39:41, then 225.56 (08:44:41), 335.56 (08:49:41) and 53.15 (08:54:41); 'ingress' errors were 4.444 and 2.222 before, then 228.89, 337.78 and 54.47.

Frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx and frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6 are both Running, ready=true with restartCount 0 at query time, so the error rate is not produced by frontend or frontend-proxy restarts.

The ad pod's last observable application log lines (current container stream, 08:38:46–08:40:13) are normal traffic only ('Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.', 'no baggage found in context'); no error line appears in that range, and no previous-container log stream was available for the pod.

The node hosting the ad pod (i-0d81a0f472ebdc704) is Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False (reason KubeletHasSufficientMemory) and DiskPressure/PIDPressure False, so the OOMKilled terminations are container-level rather than node memory pressure or eviction.

Recorded per-container memory high-water marks top out at 372,563,968 bytes (instance 0660c51865e8cb3d082c1b5d9259de4b8ec71faf1f64a02a95993e109243b14d), below the 450Mi (471,859,200 byte) limit, and container_memory_failcnt is 0 for all seven ad container instances; these series do not capture usage reaching the declared limit, so the exact allocation spike behind the OOM kill is unverified.

Primary explanation for the alert: frontend's request errors are produced by failed calls to ad service while its only replica was crash-looping. The chain supported by evidence is (a) the ad container was terminated with reason OOMKilled (two recorded terminations) and the kubelet logged 23 BackOff events 08:41:22–08:49:01, (b) the ad pod is not Ready so the ad Service exposes only a notReadyAddress and no ready endpoint, (c) frontend's GetAds client spans turn to error status in the bucket ending 08:42:08 with matching tcp.connect errors while those failing calls have no ad server-side span, (d) frontend's GET /api/data path records exactly the same error count (552) with the same onset, and (e) frontend-proxy's 'router frontend egress' errors begin in the same bucket (08:39:41–08:44:41). The intra-request propagation is inferred from identical counts and simultaneous onset, not from observed parent-child span edges, and the exact gRPC error text was not observable.

Likely deeper cause of the ad crash loop: unbounded memory growth in the ad container against a 450Mi limit (225Mi requested) with no probes and a single replica, so growth converts into repeated container restarts. The observed working set rose monotonically 331MB to 372MB between 08:16:08 and 08:41:08 while ad request volume stayed modest (1348.54 GetAds server spans over the whole 77-minute window), and the kills began within a minute of that plateau. Because recorded peaks never exceed the limit, whether the limit was actually reached or a spike fell between samples remains unverified.

A flagd / feature-flag backend problem as the cause of the frontend error rate was considered and rejected: the only flagd-related error spans are 2.033 (ad flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream), 3.044 (recommendation) and 3.048 (fraud-detection) events versus 2227.28 frontend error spans, and the flagd pod is Running and ready with restartCount 0.

Node-level memory pressure or pod eviction as the cause was considered and rejected: the ad pod's node reports MemoryPressure=False (KubeletHasSufficientMemory) and Ready=True, the pod is not Evicted and remains in phase Running, and the only kubelet Warning event is the BackOff restart of container ad.

For the ad workload: right-size or raise the container memory limit and eliminate the growth (profile the ad process heap), add readiness and liveness probes, and remove the single point of failure (more than one ad replica plus a disruption budget) so one crash-looping container cannot remove the last ready endpoint of the ad Service.

gaps: The alerting rule itself is not observable: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no_data (219e41bd-cc66-4999-b0ca-d4b4853dc45f-t0:71568108-1f38-44e0-81eb-47226efc67a0), and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="frontend"} returned no series (cb09c110-1d5e-4dff-b71b-cc3efbe03816-t0:90f98b6a-c10e-4f07-8790-3a8133d32c7f); the only span metrics present are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket, so the alert expression and the unit of the reported value 2.622222222222222 could not be verified.

Span-level error text and gRPC status of the failing frontend GetAds spans could not be read: the newest frontend traces end at 2026-11-15T08:32:24Z, before the error onset, and tag searches for error=true (219e41bd-cc66-4999-b0ca-d4b4853dc45f-t2:badb17c2-7dd8-44af-811f-0ab745fcb5d2), operation grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (b2fe85f9-1e14-4f3f-85a4-1b49c85a0efb-t0:6822a7d3-1279-4b0f-b6e4-53502be301d4), otel.status_code=ERROR (cb09c110-1d5e-4dff-b71b-cc3efbe03816-t2:9da5c7bd-941a-46dc-a490-9fb7673a4e4f) and rpc.grpc.status_code=14 (7de7f1b4-435c-456f-8ffe-9e3551fd0505-t0:2a644a4d-1e2e-45a5-a6ab-cd92331a6cc5) all returned no traces, so 'connection refused / UNAVAILABLE due to no ready endpoint' is an inference from endpoints and span counts, not a read error message.

The 516-row frontend trace search (d0920514-587a-466d-918f-a145d16bece2-t1:a21e225f-b9d4-4889-8e88-1e9a126e95bc) was RESULT_TOO_LARGE and only the first 30 rows could be read (05921fc5-f1cd-41df-9872-5c4c30782295-t0:0b61ea96-4d1d-4f1c-8c08-7fd154f78cd0, incomplete and truncated, 486 rows omitted), all from ~08:32 with successful status; the remaining rows were never inspected. No parent-child span references spanning GET -> GET /api/data -> grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds were available for the failure period, so that call edge is inferred from identical counts and onset.

Frontend application logs could not confirm the failure mode: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned 0 lines for 08:35:00–08:59:41, both unfiltered (09cdbdc3-747f-4c8e-8d1a-74d550f0a9f2-t1:d1cd8e79-db17-478c-8ae9-fe28a5883614) and with an error/timeout filter (7de7f1b4-435c-456f-8ffe-9e3551fd0505-t1:33c673c5-c3c8-4ce5-93a2-ef7f76c380d6), so the response the frontend emitted is unknown rather than absent.

The ad pod's previous-container log stream was unavailable (no previous instance found) and its current stream was truncated to the newest 150 of 2678 lines ending 08:40:13 (f67123a6-1eb7-41bb-83b2-1ba064d2b1d6-t2:0a2c50ca-3103-4672-b0e5-6a57b49806c4, incomplete), so the crash-time logs were not read.

Restart accounting is inconsistent: the container status reports restartCount 4 with current state terminated at 08:44:24Z, while cAdvisor exposes seven distinct ad container cgroups, three of which have samples after 08:44Z (up to ~08:55Z); the exact number of restarts and the pod's state at the alert time are uncertain.

The memory peak that triggered the OOMKilled terminations was not captured: recorded per-container max usage tops out at 372.5MB against a 450Mi limit and container_memory_failcnt is 0, so whether the cgroup limit was actually reached (versus an unrecorded spike) is unverified. A query for kube_pod_container_resource_limits returned no data (65db376d-2e18-4377-b06a-e17ddbd62bb2-t1:b0c8ce92-0393-405a-980d-574301cec6a0), and an attempt to read LimitRanges objects failed with INVALID_PARAMS (becdc22c-3480-4e33-a91e-848124bd68d3-t1).
Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so whether the ad container memory limit, probes or image changed before 2026-11-15T08:41Z could not be checked.

Several services were not verified at all and their health is unknown, not confirmed healthy: cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping, kafka, otel-collector, postgresql and valkey-cart produced no error-span series in this window (a missing series is unknown, not zero); only one sampled pre-onset trace showed frontend calls to CartService and CheckoutService with rpc.grpc.status_code 0.
next_steps: Inspect the ad service heap/GC behaviour and the upstream default memory limit for ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad to decide whether 450Mi is mis-sized or a leak was introduced, and check cluster change history for edits to the ad deployment resources or probes around 2026-11-15T08:41Z.

Add readiness/liveness probes to the ad container and run more than one ad replica with a PodDisruptionBudget, so a single OOM-killed container cannot remove the last ready endpoint of the ad Service.

Retrieve the frontend's gRPC error detail for AdService/GetAds from frontend stdout or collector span attributes, since Jaeger holds no traces after ~08:32, to confirm UNAVAILABLE/connection-refused rather than a deadline or application-level error.
